crossRefs.note: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”
translations.bsb: And his family name in Israel will be called “The House of the Unsandaled.”
translations.kjv: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him that hath his shoe loosed.
